No people, no readable text, no quest UI, no magic, no claimed outcome. Modest practical scale, no giant fantasy architecture. Open ordinary return path clearly visible. Geometry is a proposal, not certified collision or inventory. A coastal war-damaged village return kitchen, independent doorway to a public dry courtyard. Three distinct old pots with differently shaped handles sit on a separate low shelf, three households' history but no three beds. A SMALL stack of spare plain boards rests against one side, not installed into extra living space. Old cracked rear wall is blocked off with timber braces. No beds, new repaired rooms, infinite building materials or signed tenancy. Focus finite shared cooking capacity and public return route.
